question: In which of the following states is the Bhambavli Vajrai Waterfall located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhambavli Vajrai Waterfall**__

 
 
• The height of this waterfall is 1840 ft (560m) and it falls from a straight cliff having three steps (stages).
 
• The water for the waterfall comes from the river Urmodi. It is the origin of the river Urmodi.
 
• **The waterfall is situated in the district of Satara in western Maharashtra. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
• It is about 5 km away from the well-known Kas Flower Valley and 2 km away from Bhambavli Flower Valley.
 
• **The lush green mountains and the flowers in the nearby flower valleys please your senses.**
 
• The pleasant weather actually relaxes you like anything. But the star attraction of this place is tranquillity.
 
• The place is simply deserted and there are no hawkers, unwanted guides or cameramen to disturb you.
 
• **The waterfall is perennial in nature and hence you will hardly find any day when it’s gone dry (flows 12 months a year).**
